$comment: Manifest of external tools the entity-pipeline scripts (tools/entities3d, tools/rigbench, tools/creatureGate) bind to on THIS machine. Read by tools/entities3d/doctor.mjs — `node tools/entities3d/doctor.mjs`. Keep in sync by hand when a script's tool resolution changes; doctor.mjs only verifies what is listed here, it does not discover new bindings. See tools/entities3d/capture/captureLib.mjs for the capture-rig conventions these paths exist to support.

checks.label: Blender (rig job)
checks.installHint: Install Blender 4.2 LTS or newer (https://www.blender.org/download/lts/), or set BLENDER_EXE to the blender.exe path. Remy's install (2026-08-21) lives on F:; the probe checks C, D, E, F, G in order.

checks.label: System Chrome (headless capture)
checks.installHint: Install Google Chrome at the default location, or set CAPTURE_CHROME to chrome.exe. Playwright's bundled Chromium is NOT a substitute here: it renders black frames for these scenes (see captureLib.mjs convention 1).

checks.label: Playwright (node module)
checks.installHint: npm install (playwright is a repo dependency; it drives system Chrome, see the system-chrome entry).

checks.label: Python + numpy/PIL/scipy (maskmetrics, silhouette diff)
checks.installHint: Install Python 3 on PATH as `python`, then `pip install numpy pillow scipy`. maskmetrics.py needs all three; silhouetteDiff.py needs the stdlib only but is invoked with the same interpreter.

checks.label: ffmpeg (wave-gif capture)
checks.installHint: Install ffmpeg and set CAPTURE_FFMPEG, or install it at F:/Repos/VideoChunking/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe. Optional: wave-gif.mjs degrades gracefully and still writes frames + a sheet when ffmpeg is missing, so this is reported but does not fail the doctor.

checks.label: Main Vite dev server (port 3000)
checks.installHint: Start the main dev server: `npm run dev` (vite.config.ts default port 3000). Optional: only needed while actually running a capture; doctor reports reachability but does not fail on it.

checks.label: Shared design-preview Vite server (port 5174)
checks.installHint: captureLib.mjs DEFAULT_ORIGIN. Start a Vite dev server bound to 5174 (or override with CAPTURE_ORIGIN / CAPTURE_BASE). Optional: informational only, does not fail the doctor.
